models.page.failed: This model could not be read
models.retire.title: Retire {name}
models.retire.consequence: It leaves this list and can no longer be deployed. Its files stay in the store, and the record stays in the audit trail. To use it again, import it again.
models.origin.base: The model it was made from
models.lineage.empty.title: No dataset lineage available
models.lineage.empty.detail: This model detail has no training dataset or preparation holdout versions to show. Any known model origin is shown above.
models.import.title: Import a bundle
models.import.detail: Upload a model that was fetched on a connected machine. Every file is checked against its published hash before the model can be used.
models.import.failed: The import could not be read
models.import.tooSmall.title: This file is too small to be the bundle
models.import.tooSmall.detail: A bundle of this model is at least {minimum}. Check that the file holds every file of the model.
models.import.tooLarge.title: This file is larger than this installation accepts
models.import.tooLarge.detail: The limit is {maximum}. An administrator of the installation can raise it.
models.import.howTo.detail: In the folder containing the files for this revision, run one of these commands to create bundle.tar. Each command includes only the listed files. Upload the tar file without compressing it.
models.import.howTo.tools: On macOS, use Python 3 or GNU tar installed as gtar. The built-in macOS tar produces headers this importer rejects. Use the tar command below only if tar --version reports GNU tar.
models.import.license: I accept the {license} licence of this model for this installation.
models.import.cost: Allow about {during} in the model store during import for the bundle and the unpacked files. The model files use {size}.
models.import.cost.none: The unpacked model uses {size}. Choose a bundle to estimate the total space needed during import.
models.import.storage.title: Storage needed
models.import.storage.cleanup: After publication, the server removes temporary import files in the background.
models.import.noStore.title: This installation has no model store
models.import.noStore.detail: Nothing can be imported until the store is available. Run ownsolid-install apply on the server, then check that data/models exists and belongs to the service user.
models.import.blocked.title: {name} is still being imported
models.import.blocked.detail: A workspace takes one import at a time. Finish or discard that one first.
models.import.progress.label: Uploaded so far
models.import.keepOpen: You can use the rest of the console while this runs. Closing this tab stops the upload; it can be continued later.
models.import.step.verify.detail: The server checks each file against its published hash before it can publish the model.
models.import.resume.title: This tab is not uploading
models.import.resume.detail: Choose the same file, {size}, to continue from where it stopped.
models.import.resume.wrongSize: That file is a different size, so it is not this bundle. Choose the file this import began with.
models.import.stopping: Discarding this import. Discard it again if this stays here.
models.import.controls.loading: Loading settings for resuming or verifying this import.
models.import.controls.unavailable: The import status is available. Try again to load the settings needed to resume the upload or verify the bundle.
models.import.outOfAttempts: This import used all its tries. Discard it and import the bundle again.
models.import.published.title: Model published
models.import.published.detail: The server removes the uploaded bundle and temporary verification files in the background and retries if needed. These files may still take up space.
models.import.retryReason: Verified again from the Model library
models.import.resumeReason: Upload continued from the Model library
models.import.cancel.title: Discard the import of {name}
models.import.cancel.consequence: What was uploaded is deleted. To bring this model in, start again from the bundle.
models.import.missing.title: No such import
models.import.missing.detail: It may have been in another workspace, or the link may be wrong.
problem.MODEL_VERSION_REFERENCED.title: This model is in use
problem.MODEL_VERSION_REFERENCED.detail: A deployment, key, training run or preparation still depends on it. Stop or remove that first, then retire the model.
problem.MODEL_REFERENCE_CHECK_UNAVAILABL: Whether this model is in use could not be checked
Nothing was changed. Try again; if it repeats, give the request ID to your administrator.
problem.MODEL_PREPARATION_UNAVAILABLE.ti: Whether this model is in use could not be checked
problem.MODEL_PREPARATION_UNAVAILABLE.de: Model preparation is not available on this installation, so nothing was changed. Ask your administrator to check its configuration.
problem.MODEL_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE.title: The model store is not available
problem.MODEL_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE.detail: The server cannot open its model store. Run ownsolid-install apply on the server, then check that data/models exists and belongs to the service user.
problem.MODEL_IMPORT_BUSY.title: Another import is under way
problem.MODEL_IMPORT_BUSY.detail: A workspace takes one import at a time. Finish or discard the import in the Imports tab, then try again.
problem.MODEL_ALREADY_EXISTS.title: This workspace already has this model
problem.MODEL_ALREADY_EXISTS.detail: It is ready in Your models, so it does not need importing again.
problem.MODEL_IMPORT_STATE_CONFLICT.deta: It finished or was discarded while you were here. Open the import to see where it stands.
problem.MODEL_IMPORT_INCOMPLETE.title: The upload is not complete
problem.MODEL_IMPORT_INCOMPLETE.detail: Part of the bundle is missing, or this import used all its tries. Continue the upload, or discard it and start again.
problem.MODEL_CHUNK_INVALID.title: A part of the bundle was refused
problem.MODEL_CHUNK_INVALID.detail: The file changed or a part was damaged on the way. Check the file, then continue the upload.
problem.MODEL_CHUNK_CONFLICT.title: This is not the file this import began with
problem.MODEL_CHUNK_CONFLICT.detail: What was already uploaded does not match it. Choose the original file, or discard the import and start again.
problem.MODEL_CHUNK_OFFSET_MISMATCH.deta: The server holds a different amount than this page expected. Try again to continue from where the server is.
problem.MODEL_CLEANUP_CONFLICT.title: The upload could not be cleared
problem.MODEL_CLEANUP_CONFLICT.detail: Its files are in use or changed on the server. Try again; if it repeats, ask your administrator to check data/models.
problem.MODEL_IO_FAILED.title: The model store could not be written
problem.MODEL_IO_FAILED.detail: The disk may be full or failing. Ask your administrator to check the space under data/models, then try again.
problem.MODEL_PATH_INVALID.title: The model store is not set up correctly
problem.MODEL_PATH_INVALID.detail: A path in the store has the wrong type or owner. Ask your administrator to check data/models on the server.
problem.MODEL_RECOVERY_REQUIRED.title: This import needs recovery
problem.MODEL_RECOVERY_REQUIRED.detail: The server stopped in the middle of it. Verify again; if it fails the same way, discard it and import the bundle again.
problem.MODEL_FILE_SET_INVALID.title: The bundle holds the wrong files
problem.MODEL_FILE_SET_INVALID.detail: A file is missing or there is an extra one. Make the bundle again with every file of the model and nothing else.
problem.MODEL_FILE_INVALID.title: A file of this model is not as published
problem.MODEL_FILE_INVALID.detail: Its size or type differs from the catalogue. Fetch the model again and make a new bundle.
problem.MODEL_FILE_CHANGED.title: A file changed during verification
problem.MODEL_FILE_CHANGED.detail: Something altered the store while it was being read. Verify again.
problem.MODEL_DIGEST_MISMATCH.title: A file does not match its published hash
problem.MODEL_DIGEST_MISMATCH.detail: The uploaded bundle contains a different or damaged file. Discard this import, then fetch the model again and make a new bundle.
problem.MODEL_CANCELLED.title: Verification was interrupted
problem.MODEL_CANCELLED.detail: The server stopped before it finished. Verify again.
problem.MODEL_CONFIGURATION_INVALID.titl: The model's configuration is not valid
problem.MODEL_CONFIGURATION_INVALID.deta: Its config.json does not describe this model. Fetch the model again and make a new bundle.
problem.MODEL_TOKENIZER_INVALID.title: The model's tokenizer is not valid
problem.MODEL_TOKENIZER_INVALID.detail: Its tokenizer files are damaged. Fetch the model again and make a new bundle.
problem.MODEL_SAFETENSORS_INVALID.title: The model's weights are not valid
problem.MODEL_SAFETENSORS_INVALID.detail: Its safetensors file is damaged. Fetch the model again and make a new bundle.
problem.MODEL_STAGE_INVALID.title: Verification could not start cleanly
problem.MODEL_STAGE_INVALID.detail: An earlier try left files behind. Discard this import and import the bundle again.
problem.MODEL_ARCHIVE_INVALID.title: This file is not a valid bundle
problem.MODEL_ARCHIVE_INVALID.detail: A bundle must be an uncompressed USTAR archive containing only the approved files. Under How to make a bundle, use the Python 3 or GNU tar command that matches your tool.
problem.MODEL_PUBLICATION_CONFLICT.title: This model could not be published
problem.MODEL_PUBLICATION_CONFLICT.detai: The store already holds something different under its name. Ask your administrator to check data/models.
problem.MODEL_ACTOR_UNAVAILABLE.title: The person who started this cannot finish it
problem.MODEL_ACTOR_UNAVAILABLE.detail: Their account or access changed. Discard this import and start it again.
problem.MODEL_IMPORT_FAILED.title: The import failed
problem.MODEL_IMPORT_FAILED.detail: Verify again. If it fails the same way, discard it and import the bundle again.
command.failed.models: Models could not be searched. Select to try again.
problem.MODEL_DERIVED_CATALOG_INVALID.ti: This model's record cannot be read
problem.MODEL_DERIVED_CATALOG_INVALID.de: Its stored description does not match what the server expects. Ask your administrator to check the store.

problem.INFERENCE_CANCELLED.title: The model stopped loading
problem.INFERENCE_CANCELLED.detail: The load was cancelled before it finished. Start the deployment again.
This deployment’s settings are not valid
The agent could not build a container from them. Remove the deployment and deploy the model again.
problem.INFERENCE_CONTAINER_CONFLICT.tit: A container is in the way on this node
problem.INFERENCE_CONTAINER_CONFLICT.det: A container the platform does not own has the name it needs. Remove that container on the node and try again.
problem.INFERENCE_DISK_SPACE_LOW.title: This node is short of disk space
problem.INFERENCE_DISK_SPACE_LOW.detail: The model and its cache do not fit. Free space on the node and try again.
problem.INFERENCE_DOCKER_NOT_FOUND.title: Docker does not have what it was asked for
problem.INFERENCE_DOCKER_NOT_FOUND.detai: The container or network has gone from the node. Check the deployment again to see where it stands.
problem.INFERENCE_DOCKER_REJECTED.title: Docker refused the request
problem.INFERENCE_DOCKER_REJECTED.detail: Docker on the node would not carry it out. Check the Docker service on the node and try again.
This node’s Docker cannot be used
Serving needs rootful Docker on the root-owned socket /run/docker.sock. Rootless Docker is not supported.
problem.INFERENCE_DOCKER_UNAVAILABLE.tit: Docker is not answering on this node
problem.INFERENCE_DOCKER_UNAVAILABLE.det: Start the Docker service on the node and try again.
problem.INFERENCE_DRIVER_UNSUPPORTED.tit: This GPU’s driver is too old
problem.INFERENCE_DRIVER_UNSUPPORTED.det: Serving needs NVIDIA driver 580 or newer. Upgrade the driver on the node, then read its GPUs again.
problem.INFERENCE_EGRESS_GUARD_UNAVAILAB: The network guard could not be set up
Models run with no way out to the network, and the node could not enforce that. Check that nftables works on the node.
problem.INFERENCE_GPU_BUSY.title: Another process is using this GPU
problem.INFERENCE_GPU_BUSY.detail: Something outside the platform runs on it. Stop that process or choose another GPU.
problem.INFERENCE_GPU_MEMORY_LOW.title: This GPU does not have enough memory free
problem.INFERENCE_GPU_MEMORY_LOW.detail: A model needs a GPU of at least 8 GiB with most of its memory free. Free the GPU or choose another.
problem.INFERENCE_GPU_OOM.title: The model ran out of GPU memory
problem.INFERENCE_GPU_OOM.detail: The GPU could not hold it while loading or serving. Choose a GPU with more memory.
problem.INFERENCE_GPU_PROBE_INVALID.titl: This node’s GPUs could not be read
problem.INFERENCE_GPU_PROBE_INVALID.deta: nvidia-smi gave an answer the agent does not understand. Check the driver on the node, then read its GPUs again.
problem.INFERENCE_GPU_UNAVAILABLE.title: This GPU is not on the node any more
problem.INFERENCE_GPU_UNAVAILABLE.detail: The node’s last report does not list it. Read the node’s GPUs again and choose one it reports.
problem.INFERENCE_GPU_UNSUPPORTED.title: This GPU is too old for the model
problem.INFERENCE_GPU_UNSUPPORTED.detail: Its compute capability is below what the model needs. Choose a newer GPU.
problem.INFERENCE_HOST_MEMORY_LOW.title: This node does not have enough memory
problem.INFERENCE_HOST_MEMORY_LOW.detail: Serving needs at least 12 GiB of memory on the node. Choose another node.
problem.INFERENCE_IMAGE_INVALID.title: The serving image on this node is not the approved one
problem.INFERENCE_IMAGE_INVALID.detail: Its digest or CUDA version differs. Load the approved vLLM image on the node and try again.
problem.INFERENCE_IMAGE_MISSING.title: The serving image is not on this node
problem.INFERENCE_IMAGE_MISSING.detail: Load the approved vLLM image on the node with docker load, then read its GPUs again. Adding a node shows how.
problem.INFERENCE_IMAGE_UNAVAILABLE.titl: The serving image could not be read
problem.INFERENCE_IMAGE_UNAVAILABLE.deta: Docker could not inspect it on this node. Check the Docker service and try again.
problem.INFERENCE_IO_FAILED.title: The node could not read or write the model’s files
problem.INFERENCE_IO_FAILED.detail: Check the permissions and health of the agent’s data directory, then try again.
problem.INFERENCE_LOAD_TIMEOUT.title: The model did not finish loading in time
problem.INFERENCE_LOAD_TIMEOUT.detail: It may still be too large for this node, or the node may be overloaded. Start it again, or choose another node.
problem.INFERENCE_MIG_UNSUPPORTED.title: This GPU is partitioned with MIG
problem.INFERENCE_MIG_UNSUPPORTED.detail: Serving takes a whole GPU. Turn MIG off on it, or choose another GPU.
problem.INFERENCE_MODEL_INVALID.title: The model’s files on this node are damaged
problem.INFERENCE_MODEL_INVALID.detail: They differ from what was approved. Remove the deployment and deploy the model again to fetch them afresh.
problem.INFERENCE_NETWORK_CONFLICT.title: A network is in the way on this node
problem.INFERENCE_NETWORK_CONFLICT.detai: A Docker network the platform does not own has the name it needs. Remove that network on the node and try again.
problem.INFERENCE_NOT_READY.title: The model did not become ready
problem.INFERENCE_NOT_READY.detail: Its container started, but the model did not answer. Open the deployment’s last task for what it reported.
problem.INFERENCE_NVIDIA_UNAVAILABLE.tit: No NVIDIA driver answers on this node
problem.INFERENCE_NVIDIA_UNAVAILABLE.det: nvidia-smi is missing or failing. Install the driver on the node, then read its GPUs again.
problem.INFERENCE_OOM.title: The model’s container ran out of memory
problem.INFERENCE_OOM.detail: The system stopped it. Free memory on the node, or choose a node with more.
problem.INFERENCE_OPERATION_FAILED.title: The node could not carry this out
problem.INFERENCE_OPERATION_FAILED.detai: Open the deployment’s last task for what it reported, then try again.
problem.INFERENCE_OWNERSHIP_CONFLICT.tit: This deployment no longer matches what is on the node
problem.INFERENCE_OWNERSHIP_CONFLICT.det: Something else changed the node’s container or task. Check the deployment again before acting on it.
problem.INFERENCE_PLATFORM_UNSUPPORTED.t: This node’s system cannot serve models yet
problem.INFERENCE_PLATFORM_UNSUPPORTED.d: Serving needs Ubuntu 24.04 on amd64. See What is supported for the systems of this release.
problem.INFERENCE_PORT_CONFLICT.title: The serving port is in use on this node
problem.INFERENCE_PORT_CONFLICT.detail: Something else listens on the port the model needs. Stop it and try again.
problem.INFERENCE_PREFLIGHT_REQUIRED.tit: This node’s GPUs have not been read recently
problem.INFERENCE_PREFLIGHT_REQUIRED.det: What it last reported is too old to rely on. Read its GPUs again, then try again.
problem.INFERENCE_RECOVERY_REQUIRED.deta: The platform cannot tell what is running on it, so it stays held. Recover the node before starting anything on the GPU.
problem.INFERENCE_RESOURCE_BUSY.title: This node or GPU already serves a deployment
problem.INFERENCE_RESOURCE_BUSY.detail: A node serves one deployment and a GPU belongs to one. Remove that deployment or choose another node.
problem.INFERENCE_RESOURCE_LIMITS_UNAVAI: Docker on this node cannot enforce limits
Models run with memory, swap, process and CPU limits, and this host’s kernel or Docker lacks one. Enable them on the node.
problem.INFERENCE_RESPONSE_INVALID.title: The model’s test answer was not valid
problem.INFERENCE_RESPONSE_INVALID.detai: It answered the verification prompt in a form the agent does not accept. Verify again; if it repeats, deploy the model again.
problem.INFERENCE_REVISION_CONFLICT.titl: The node is on another revision of this deployment
problem.INFERENCE_REVISION_CONFLICT.deta: Another request changed it first. Check the deployment again before acting on it.
problem.INFERENCE_STATE_INVALID.title: The agent’s record of this deployment is damaged
problem.INFERENCE_STATE_INVALID.detail: It cannot be trusted, so nothing was changed. Check the deployment again; if it repeats, remove it.
problem.INFERENCE_TOOLKIT_UNAVAILABLE.ti: Docker on this node cannot reach its GPUs
problem.INFERENCE_TOOLKIT_UNAVAILABLE.de: The NVIDIA Container Toolkit is missing. Install it on the node, then read its GPUs again.
problem.NODE_UNAVAILABLE.title: This node is not online
problem.NODE_UNAVAILABLE.detail: The agent has stopped reporting. Bring the node back, or choose another.
problem.REGISTRY_OWNER_REQUIRED.title: This deployment needs the image registry service
problem.REGISTRY_OWNER_REQUIRED.detail: It was deployed through the in-site registry, which this installation is not running. Start the registry and try again.
problem.API_KEY_ALREADY_ROTATED.detail: Someone rotated it a moment ago. Use the key that replaced it, or rotate that one.
problem.API_KEY_ALREADY_ROTATED.title: This key was already rotated
problem.API_KEY_NOT_ACTIVE.detail: This key has expired, was revoked or lost its owner's access. Issue a new key instead.
problem.API_KEY_NOT_ACTIVE.title: Only a working key can be rotated
problem.API_KEY_ROTATION_UNAVAILABLE.det: This installation's database cannot record a key's replacement. Revoke the key and issue a new one instead.
problem.MODEL_ALIAS_UNAVAILABLE.detail: Its deployment is not running or the gateway serving it was revoked. Start the deployment in Model services, then try again.
problem.MODEL_ALIAS_UNAVAILABLE.title: This model cannot be called now

gateway.secret.lost.title: The key was made, but its secret cannot be shown again
gateway.secret.lost.detail: The answer that carried it was lost. Revoke this key and issue another.
gateway.rotate.title: Rotate {name}
gateway.rotate.detail: The key gets a new secret, shown once. It keeps its name, model and owner.
gateway.rotate.overlap.0: Not at all: stop it now
gateway.rotate.now: Calls with the old secret fail from now on. Use this when the secret leaked.
gateway.rotate.until: Both secrets work until {time}; then only the new one does.
gateway.revoke.title: Revoke {name}
gateway.revoke.consequence: Calls to {model} with this key fail from now on, and it cannot be used again.

nodes.add.kubernetes.unconfigured: Kubernetes cells are not set up. Ask the operator to enable them.
nodes.add.kubernetes.permission: You do not have permission to check this cell’s Kubernetes setup. Ask a platform administrator.

nodes.add.kubernetes.rejectedDetail: Control refused to issue a token for this role. Ask the operator to check PostgreSQL and the Kubernetes cell setup.

audit.action.gateway.instance_activated: Gateway started by its node's agent
services.gateway.title: On the gateway
services.gateway.subtitle: Keys call a deployment through the gateway by the name it is published under.
services.gateway.none: Not published. Publish it under a name, then issue keys that call that name.
services.gateway.partial: This workspace has more names than could be read here; this deployment may already be published.
services.gateway.blocked.removed: A removed deployment cannot be published. Deploy the model again to publish it.
services.gateway.blocked.notRunning: It can be published once it is running. Start it, or wait until its node reports it running.
services.gateway.blocked.notVerified: It can be published once a test generation has checked its answer. Choose Verify on this page.
services.gateway.publish.title: Publish to the gateway
services.gateway.publish.detail: Give {model} the name callers send as the model. Keys are issued for this name.
services.gateway.publish.doneDetail: Callers send {name} as the model to {url}. Issue a key for it from this page.
services.gateway.publish.name: Name
services.gateway.publish.name.hint: Lower-case letters, digits, dots and hyphens, starting with a letter; at most 64. A name is used once in a workspace.
services.gateway.publish.name.empty: Enter the name callers will use.
services.gateway.publish.name.characters: Use only lower-case letters, digits, dots and hyphens, at most 64.
services.gateway.new.title: No gateway serves {node} yet
services.gateway.new.detail: Publishing registers one. Its credential is shown once, for the gateway process on that node.
services.gateway.new.origin.hint: The HTTPS address callers reach this gateway at, such as https://gateway.example.internal:8443. It is shown to callers, never called by the platform.
services.gateway.new.origin.invalid: Enter an HTTPS address with no path, such as https://gateway.example.internal.
services.gateway.new.name: Gateway name
services.gateway.new.name.hint: How the gateway is called on these pages.
services.gateway.new.name.required: Enter a name for the gateway.
services.gateway.agent.title: {node}'s agent will start a gateway
services.gateway.agent.detail: The agent runs it beside the model, with a credential that never leaves the node. Callers reach it at the address in the node's agent configuration.
services.gateway.agent.startingDetail: The model is published as soon as the gateway serves. You can close this window; publishing again later continues where it stopped.
services.gateway.agent.failed: The gateway did not start on {node}
services.gateway.agent.failedDetail: Fix what the node reports, then replace the gateway and publish again.
services.gateway.credential.once: Copy the gateway's credential now. It is shown only this once.
services.gateway.credential.title: The gateway's identity
services.gateway.credential.use: Configure the gateway on {node} with these IDs and put the credential in its credential file. Callers reach it at {origin}.
services.gateway.lost.title: The gateway was registered, but its credential cannot be shown again
services.gateway.lost.detail: The answer that carried it was lost. Revoke this gateway and register another; nothing has been published to it.
services.gateway.name: Name
services.gateway.unavailable.detail: Its deployment is not running as checked, or its gateway was revoked. Keys for this name are refused until it is.
services.gateway.stop.title: Stop publishing {name}?
services.gateway.stop.consequence: Calls to {name} are refused from now on, and the name cannot be published again. The deployment keeps running.
problem.GATEWAY_NODE_UNAVAILABLE.title: This node cannot run a gateway now
problem.GATEWAY_NODE_UNAVAILABLE.detail: The node is not active, does not serve models, or was fenced. Check the node on its page, then try again.
problem.GATEWAY_INSTANCE_EXISTS.title: This node already has a gateway
problem.GATEWAY_INSTANCE_EXISTS.detail: Someone registered it meanwhile. It is shown now; publish to it.
The node declares its gateway's address
This node's agent runs the gateway, so its address comes from the node's agent configuration. Leave the address out.
problem.GATEWAY_NOT_STARTED.title: The gateway is not running yet
problem.GATEWAY_NOT_STARTED.detail: The node's agent is still starting it, or could not. Publish once it runs.
problem.GATEWAY_INSTANCE_INACTIVE.title: The gateway was revoked
problem.GATEWAY_INSTANCE_INACTIVE.detail: It was revoked while its node started it. Publish again to start a new one.
problem.GATEWAY_AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE.de: The installation has no model gateway CA. Apply the installation again, then retry.
problem.GATEWAY_NOT_CONFIGURED.title: The node declares no gateway
problem.GATEWAY_NOT_CONFIGURED.detail: Add a gateway section to the node's agent configuration, with its listen address, origin and image, then restart the agent and replace the gateway.
problem.GATEWAY_CONFIGURATION_INVALID.de: Check the gateway section of the node's agent configuration, then replace the gateway.
problem.GATEWAY_IMAGE_MISSING.title: The gateway image is not on this node
problem.GATEWAY_IMAGE_MISSING.detail: Load the model gateway image on the node with docker load and set its ID in the agent configuration, then replace the gateway.
problem.GATEWAY_IMAGE_INVALID.title: The gateway image does not match
problem.GATEWAY_IMAGE_INVALID.detail: The image the agent configuration names is not a Linux amd64 gateway image. Load the right one, then replace the gateway.
problem.GATEWAY_DOCKER_UNAVAILABLE.title: Docker is unavailable on the node
problem.GATEWAY_DOCKER_UNAVAILABLE.detai: Start Docker on the node, then replace the gateway.
problem.GATEWAY_DOCKER_REJECTED.title: Docker refused the gateway
problem.GATEWAY_DOCKER_REJECTED.detail: Read the node's Docker log, fix what it reports, then replace the gateway.
problem.GATEWAY_CONTAINER_CONFLICT.title: Another container holds the gateway's name
problem.GATEWAY_CONTAINER_CONFLICT.detai: Remove the leftover container on the node, then replace the gateway.
problem.GATEWAY_ACTIVATION_REFUSED.title: Control refused the gateway's credential
problem.GATEWAY_ACTIVATION_REFUSED.detai: The start lost its task, or the node's agent cannot reach control. Replace the gateway to try again.
problem.GATEWAY_IO_FAILED.title: The gateway's files could not be written
problem.GATEWAY_IO_FAILED.detail: Check the free space and permissions of the gateway root on the node, then replace the gateway.
problem.GATEWAY_START_FAILED.title: The gateway exited at start
problem.GATEWAY_START_FAILED.detail: Read the gateway container's log on the node; a port in use or an address the node does not have are common causes.
problem.GATEWAY_NOT_READY.title: The gateway did not start serving
problem.GATEWAY_NOT_READY.detail: It ran but did not answer on its listen address in time. Read its container log on the node, then replace the gateway.
problem.GATEWAY_STOP_FAILED.title: The gateway could not be stopped
problem.GATEWAY_STOP_FAILED.detail: Docker did not stop it. Stop the container on the node, then revoke the gateway again.
problem.GATEWAY_CANCELLED.title: The gateway task was stopped
problem.GATEWAY_CANCELLED.detail: The agent stopped before it finished. Replace the gateway to try again.
problem.GATEWAY_TASK_EXPIRED.title: The node never finished the gateway task
problem.GATEWAY_TASK_EXPIRED.detail: Its agent did not report in time. Check that the node is online, then replace the gateway.
problem.GATEWAY_INSTANCE_REVOKED.title: This gateway was revoked
problem.GATEWAY_INSTANCE_REVOKED.detail: Nothing can be published to it. Close this dialog and publish again to register a new gateway.
problem.MODEL_ALIAS_EXISTS.title: This name is taken
problem.MODEL_ALIAS_EXISTS.detail: The workspace already uses it, or used it before. Choose another name.
problem.MODEL_ALIAS_NOT_FOUND.title: This name is no longer published
problem.MODEL_ALIAS_NOT_FOUND.detail: It was removed meanwhile. Reload the page to see what is published now.
problem.ALIAS_PAUSE_REQUIRED.title: This alias must be paused
problem.ALIAS_PAUSE_REQUIRED.detail: Pause the alias and wait for its active calls to release capacity. Then preview the target change again.
problem.ALIAS_ALREADY_PAUSED.title: This alias is already paused
problem.ALIAS_ALREADY_PAUSED.detail: Refresh the alias state. If you plan to change its target, wait for active calls to release capacity before previewing the change.
problem.ALIAS_NOT_PAUSED.title: This alias is already enabled
problem.ALIAS_NOT_PAUSED.detail: Refresh the alias state and check its current target. Resume applies to an alias that is paused.
problem.ALIAS_REQUESTS_UNDRAINED.title: Existing calls still hold capacity
problem.ALIAS_REQUESTS_UNDRAINED.detail: Keep the alias paused. Preview the change again after its existing calls have released capacity.
problem.ALIAS_ROLLBACK_TARGET_INVALID.ti: The rollback target does not match the recorded version
problem.ALIAS_ROLLBACK_TARGET_INVALID.de: Read the alias's target history again. Select a recorded version and a ready deployment with the matching model and serving configuration, then preview the rollback.
problem.DATASET_NOT_FOUND.title: This dataset or draft is unavailable
problem.DATASET_NOT_FOUND.detail: Check the selected workspace and choose a dataset and draft you can access. If you need access, ask your workspace administrator.
problem.DATASET_FILE_INVALID.title: A required file could not be verified
problem.DATASET_FILE_INVALID.detail: Ask an administrator to restore the verified files before trying again. For a tokenizer preview, you can also select a model with verified tokenizer files.
problem.DATASET_EMPTY_SOURCE.title: There are no rows to process
problem.DATASET_EMPTY_SOURCE.detail: Add rows to the draft or choose a source that contains rows, then try again.
problem.DATASET_VALIDATION_FAILED.title: Some rows failed dataset validation
problem.DATASET_VALIDATION_FAILED.detail: Review the validation errors and correct or replace the affected rows before trying again.
problem.DATASET_PROCESSOR_TIMEOUT.title: Dataset processing exceeded its time limit
problem.DATASET_PROCESSOR_TIMEOUT.detail: Wait for the indicated delay, then try a smaller sample or source. If it still times out, ask an administrator to check the processing time limit.
problem.DATASET_PROCESSOR_MEMORY_EXCEEDE: Dataset processing exceeded its memory limit
Wait for the indicated delay, then try a smaller sample or source. If it happens again, ask an administrator to check the processor's memory limit.
problem.DATASET_DATA_INVALID.title: The dataset result could not be read
problem.DATASET_DATA_INVALID.detail: Try again after the indicated delay. If the problem persists, ask an administrator to check the dataset and its processing service.
problem.DATASET_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE.titl: Dataset storage or processing is unavailable
problem.DATASET_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE.deta: Try again after the indicated delay. If the problem persists, ask an administrator to check the storage and processing services.
problem.CONFIG_MACHINE_TRANSPORT_REQUIRE: The installation has no HTTPS address for gateways
A gateway signs in to the control plane over HTTPS. An operator configures the machine address in the installation, then try again.
